description: This file defines a composable UI component called HomeCard used to display content cards in an Android TV app interface. It includes two layout variants: a default poster card with progress and title, and a TV channel variant with additional elements like live badge and channel icon. The code uses Jetpack Compose and Coil for image loading, with accessibility considerations implemented via semantics. It also defines parameters for layout sizing, styling, focus handling, and content description.

methods.name: HomeCard
methods.description: Main composable that selects between default poster and TV channel card layouts based on variant parameter.

methods.name: DefaultPosterCard
methods.description: Private composable implementing the default content poster card with image, progress bar, and title.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Private composable implementing the 'channel' variant with poster, label texts, live badge, progress bar, and channel icon.
